verdict.rationale: LegalZoom documents a registered agent service: it handles the paperwork to switch registered agents and covers state fees, sends an alert as soon as official mail arrives, and provides unlimited cloud storage for business documents. Digital delivery of that mail is implied by the alert and storage features but never stated outright. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that mail is scanned and uploaded, explicit mention of service-of-process handling and forwarding, independent or hands-on corroboration of the registered agent mail workflow.
